description: Optional local deterministic media acquisition and processing using trusted yt-dlp and FFmpeg/ffprobe executables.
responsibility_note: Use local tools responsibly and only on content/systems you are allowed to access.

limitations: Acquisition mechanics only; does not establish semantic visual/audio understanding.
Do not use AURA to bypass access controls, DRM, authentication restrictions, or unavailable permissions.
Deterministic media mechanics only; semantic interpretation still requires a capable model/harness.
Inspects deterministic media structure/metadata; does not prove the meaning of visual or spoken content.

installers.notes: Use the official Homebrew formulas. A healthy existing standard ffmpeg installation is accepted; ffmpeg-full is the enhanced Homebrew install path when the user opts in.
